name: Spread Creek Designated Camping Area
note: Bridger-Teton NF designated undeveloped sites along Lower Spread Creek Road (FR 30290), which leaves US 26/89 about 25.5 mi north of Jackson and runs east past the Moran Vista RV lot along Spread Creek; camping only at the marked, numbered sites. The Forest Service says some sites take RVs but codes the road for high-clearance vehicles, and campers report it rougher past the first mile, muddy after rain and roughest on the fork to the last sites: scout before taking a rig in, or call the Blackrock Ranger District first. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Bridger-Teton NF camping page (read 2026-11-20), Jackson and Blackrock Designated Undeveloped Sites table: 'Spread Creek - No. First come, first served. - From Jackson, take Hwy 26/89 north 25.5 miles. Turn right and follow Forest Road 30290 to designated sites. - Some sites can accommodate larger groups and RVs.'; Forest Order 04-03-24-204 names the 'Spread Creek designated camping area' (Blackrock RD); The Dyrt reviews report a 38-ft motorhome to the road's end (2020), a 24-ft toy hauler at site 10 (2020) and 'easy to drive in our RV' (2024) -> agency-designated drive-in sites some RVs fit (small free NF sites rule, call-first caveat). Not on recreation.gov (search 2026-11-20).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World_Imagery at 43.7725,-110.4900 (rendered; part cloud) and over FR 30290 (USFS EDW road layer drawn on): the designated sites sit on spurs along a bench and forest edge beside Spread Creek's ~150-250 m braided gravel floodplain; the active braids are under ~30 m (creek, not river) and lie ~100 m+ from the spur roads across scrub and scattered trees. The Dyrt (2026 review): 'Only 1 campsite is truly on the creek, the rest are a walk to the creek'; site numbers are not posted by the FS and I could not tie any numbered RV site to the bank -> default down to not waterfront.
fees_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins ('Dispersed camping (outside campgrounds) is free'; Spread Creek row lists no fee, first come, first served), read 2026-11-20

booking.note: 5-night limit May 1 through Labor Day (Order 04-03-24-204); 14 nights in 30 the rest of the year. Camping only at the marked, designated sites.

booking_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins ('No. First come, first served.'; 'camping is permitted only at marked, designated sites'; 14 days within any 30-day period forest-wide) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/alerts/camping-5-day-stay-limit-jackson-blackrock-big-piney-greys-river-ranger (Order 04-03-24-204, Described Area A five-day limit May 1 - Labor Day: 'Toppings, Spread Creek, Pacific Creek, and Colter Dump designated camping areas within Blackrock Ranger District') + recreation.gov search (no listing), read 2026-11-20
hookups_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins ('RV Camping: ... No hookups or dump stations are available, so RVs must be self-contained'), read 2026-11-20
facilities_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r04/bridger-teton/recreation/camping-cabins (designated undeveloped sites: 'be bring all necessary supplies including water, garbage bags, and a shovel'; 'No hookups or dump stations are available'), read 2026-11-20
flags: ACCESS JUDGEMENT CALL: the USFS EDW road layer (EDW_RoadBasic_01, queried 2026-11-20) codes all of FR 30290 'LOWER SPREAD CREEK' (2.7 mi) and its spurs 30290A-D at maintenance level '2 - HIGH CLEARANCE VEHICLES', 'Road, Not Maintained for Passenger Car'. The 497 Mower Tract ruling (2026-10-22) treated that coding as a high-clearance statement. I added anyway because the FS's own recreation text for this area says 'Some sites can accommodate larger groups and RVs' with no road warning (unlike its Mosquito Creek, Flat Creek and Phillips Ridge rows), and the same ML2 road serves Moran Vista 6493, which the FS calls 'Great area for large RVs'. If the ML2 coding should rule, this is a skip ('agency road layer: high-clearance only') - and 6493 sits on the same road.

Proximity: my pin (spur 30290A midpoint, the creek-bench sites) is ~1.7 km from Moran Vista 6493; the westernmost designated spurs (30290C/D, 'DISPERSED CAMP SPUR') are ~0.4 km south-east of that lot. Separate FS-listed area (designated numbered sites vs the open RV lot), so not a duplicate, but the reviewer may prefer one entry.
District: the lead said Jackson RD; Forest Orders 04-03-313 and 04-03-24-204 put Spread Creek in the Blackrock Ranger District, so the phone is Blackrock's 307-543-3900.

Reviewer access reports (The Dyrt, read 2026-11-20): rougher after the first mile/forest boundary (2021), mud after heavy rain (2022), 'road is not wide enough for large rigs' past the gravel lot (2021), 4WD recommended for the right-hand fork to sites 10-13 (Sep 2026); a 2021 review mentions a 'pay to stay area for big rv's' - unconfirmed by the FS. No sites/season groups returned: the FS gives no count or dates (The Dyrt's '14 numbered sites, 1-13a' is aggregator).
